title: Peekaboo Meadow: the big update
message: Peekaboo Meadow has grown. There's a softer new look, two new places to visit with ten new animals, a colouring room, and a gentle bedtime wind-down: the sun sets, the moon comes out and every animal says goodnight before falling asleep. Lovely for the last game before bed.

items: New places: the farm and the beach, each with five animals to find
Colouring: eight pictures and twelve colours, purple included
Bedtime wind-down: tap the moon, or set a timer in the grown-ups menu
A softer, gentler look with the same bold colours

title: Solaris Gambit Update 5: Earth & Wind
message: The last two elements are here. Gorran Deepdelve has lived inside the same mountain for forty years, and sky-pirate Kestrel Vane has spent most of them raiding it. Beat the Hexbound Stranger to meet them, then collect all 15 cards to raise the Skyroot Colossus. We've also made saves safer and moved the Gauntlet to unlock after all eight rivals.

items: Two new rivals: Gorran Deepdelve and Kestrel Vane
15 new Earth & Wind cards and their own pack in the shop
Skyroot Colossus legend and Stone and Sky achievement
Safer saves: a backup copy restores your progress if it goes missing
Chapter legends stay a mystery until you beat both rivals

title: Solaris Gambit Update 4: Water & Thunder
message: The third chapter rolls in off the coast. Vael Stormcrow whips up the storms and Mother Nerissa has spent thirty years calming the seas he churns. Beat Lady Corvina to meet them, then collect all 15 cards to raise the Maelstrom Leviathan.

items: Two new rivals: Vael Stormcrow and Mother Nerissa
15 new Water & Thunder cards and their own pack in the shop
Maelstrom Leviathan legend for completing the set
Calm and Storm achievement

title: Solaris Gambit Update 3: Shadow & Holy
message: A new chapter about two old allies turned enemies. Sir Caedric the Fallen broke his oath to the cathedral, and Oracle Seraphine has never forgiven him. Beat Sel & Nara to unlock it, and collect all 15 cards to earn the Eclipse Seraph.

items: Two new rivals: Sir Caedric the Fallen and Oracle Seraphine
15 new Shadow & Holy cards and their own pack in the shop
Eclipse Seraph legend for completing the set
Light and Shade achievement, and chapter cards in Gauntlet drafts

title: Python Kitchen 2.2: your pass, your specials
message: The pass now fills up as you learn: every ticket you clear adds a piece of kit, from a chopping board to pots, pans and a service bell, until it's a proper busy working pass. There's a recipe binder with a short page on every new idea, and graduates can write their own tickets and send them to friends as Chef's specials.

items: The pass fills up with kit as you clear tickets
Recipe binder: a page on every new idea
Chef's specials: write and share your own tickets

title: Python Kitchen 2.1: graduation day
message: Python Kitchen has a proper main menu, a one-minute guided tour of your first ticket, a quick recap quiz after each service, and a brand-new graduation project: build a working till that takes orders, catches bad input and prints a receipt. Clear it to become Chef Patron.

items: Main menu with settings, reviews, Ko-fi and install
Guided first ticket for brand-new coders
Recap quizzes after every service
Graduation project: ticket 25, The Pass Is Yours
Chef's voice is now off by default

title: Fairway Tales: play with friends online
message: You can now play Fairway Tales with your friends, each on your own phone, wherever you are. Make a room, send the code, and up to four of you play the same nine holes with the same pins and the same wind. Scores update live between holes, and a little pop-up tells you when a friend makes a birdie.

items: Play with friends online: rooms for up to 4 players with live scores
Fixed a rare freeze that could lock the game after a short backspin shot
Skyreach best rounds now appear on the online leaderboard

title: Fairway Tales 1.0: the story is complete!
message: Fairway Tales has reached version 1.0. Chapter 5 takes you to Skyreach for the Tour Championship: a clifftop course above the clouds, with chasms to carry and the world number one waiting in the final. Win it and the story gets a proper ending.

items: Chapter 5: Skyreach, with 9 new holes, 4 new rivals and 4 new epic clubs
Club rework: every club starts at 10, and rarity and level boost your fitted parts
Pick your ball: Distance, Tour, Soft or Heavy
Friendlier first few minutes, with tips on your first shots and a quick-start guide

title: New for kids: Peekaboo Meadow!
message: Our first game for little ones is here. A sunny meadow where everything does something when you tap it: animals pop out of the bushes, the sun giggles and clouds rain flowers. A friendly voice asks your little one to find each animal, so no reading is needed and nobody ever loses.

items: Find the bunny, hedgehog, fox, frog and bird to fill the star jar
Balloon party every five stars
Press-and-hold grown-ups settings for sounds, voice and the find-it game

title: New game: Garage Code!
message: Game number six is the second learn-to-code game, this time set in a car garage. Les the foreman hands you jobs, you write Python to sign them off, and the car on the ramp reacts to every line you write. No experience needed.

items: 10 jobs from print() to functions, with a short manual page for each new idea
Tyre checks, fault codes and a boss-level MOT day tested on hidden cars
Make your own jobs and share them with a mate

title: New game: Python Kitchen!
message: Game number five is a bit different: it teaches you to code. Chef Dorran calls the orders from the pass, you write real Python to clear each ticket, and you work your way up from Kitchen Porter to Head Chef. No experience needed.

items: 24 tickets across breakfast, lunch, dinner and late service
Practice station and a full Python cookbook with runnable examples
Installs to your home screen and plays offline

title: New game: Metropolitan Misadventure!
message: Game number four is here. A slapstick open-world crime caper where you nick cars, run dodgy jobs for five district contacts and build a criminal empire. Free to play and installable like the others.

items: Five districts, each with its own contact and story chain
Jobs, safe houses, businesses and a casino
Installs to your home screen and plays offline

title: Introducing the public leaderboards!
message: Both games now have online leaderboards, so you can see how you stack up against everyone else.

items: New public leaderboard: who caught what
Catches show fish size and star rating
New daily challenge leaderboard
Best round on each course
Holes-in-one hall of fame
